title: Your Sailing Logbook — Data Guide
description: Explains what data is tracked about your sailing and what it means for you as a sailor

logbook.what_it_is: Every time your vessel moves under power or sail, a trip (log entry) is automatically recorded
logbook.what_it_contains: Start and end time, departure and arrival location names, distance sailed (nautical miles), duration, GPS track, average and maximum speed, and sensor readings along the route
logbook.how_to_use: Browse your sailing history, analyse specific passages, find your longest trip, most recent voyage, or trips to a specific destination

stays.what_it_is: Every time your vessel is stationary — anchored, docked, or on a mooring buoy — a stay is recorded
stays.what_it_contains: Arrival and departure time, duration, location, type (Anchor / Dock / Mooring Buoy)
stays.how_to_use: Find how long you spent at anchor, which marinas you visited, total time docked vs at anchor, or nights spent in specific areas

moorages.what_it_is: Named places where you have stopped — automatically created by grouping nearby stays within 300 metres into a single location
moorages.what_it_contains: Location name (from reverse geocoding), GPS position, number of visits, total time spent, default stay type
moorages.how_to_use: Find your most-visited anchorages or marinas, browse all places you have been, discover nearby anchorages you have not visited yet

monitoring.what_it_is: Real-time and historical sensor data from your vessel's instruments

sensors_available.navigation: GPS position, speed over ground (SOG), course over ground (COG), heading
sensors_available.environment: True wind speed and direction, water temperature, depth below transducer, outside air temperature, barometric pressure
sensors_available.electrical: Battery charge (%), battery voltage, solar panel power and voltage
sensors_available.comfort: Inside temperature, inside and outside humidity, inside pressure

monitoring.how_to_use: Check current vessel status and position, review sensor trends over recent days, monitor battery health, track weather conditions experienced during a passage

units.note: Values returned by the API reflect user preferences set in their profile (metric or imperial)
units.distance: Nautical miles (NM) for trip distances and moorage statistics
units.speed: Knots for speed over ground and wind speed

data_freshness.live_monitoring: Updated in near real-time when the vessel is connected
data_freshness.logbook: Trip entries created automatically at the end of each passage
data_freshness.stays: Recorded in real-time as the vessel transitions between moving and stationary
data_freshness.moorages: Updated after each new stay at the location

common_sailing_terms.NM: Nautical mile — 1.852 km, the standard unit for distances at sea
common_sailing_terms.SOG: Speed over ground — actual speed relative to the sea floor
common_sailing_terms.COG: Course over ground — actual direction of travel relative to the sea floor
common_sailing_terms.anchoring: Vessel at anchor — stay type recorded as 'Anchor'
common_sailing_terms.mooring_buoy: Vessel tied to a fixed mooring buoy — stay type 'Mooring Buoy'
common_sailing_terms.dock: Vessel alongside a pontoon or quay — stay type 'Dock'
